model.realisation: quadratic super-polynomials on V = V0+V1 with super Poisson bracket, kappa odd
model.gb_parity: even (rational scalars), so that [b,a] = -gb*kappa has parity 1
model.gamma: kappa-linear part of the Poisson bracket, kappa on the left
model.coboundary: f = s*D_gb, D(b_j^s) = -sum_sigma gb[-sigma,j,s] a^sigma, D(a)=0
